title: Daily briefing: The future of psychedelics
title_zh: 每日简报：迷幻药物的未来
abstract: Despite setbacks, pharma companies are betting big on psychedelic drugs to treat mental-health conditions. Plus, longevity researchers are turning their attention to pets and how to keep tabs on the tools in your lab.
abstract_zh: 尽管遇到挫折，制药公司仍对用迷幻药物治疗精神健康状况寄予厚望。此外，长寿研究人员正将注意力转向宠物以及如何监控实验室中的工具。
snippet: Despite setbacks, pharma companies are betting big on psychedelic drugs to treat mental-health conditions. Plus, longevity researchers are turning their attention to pets and how to keep tabs on the tools in your lab.
